tools.name: list_charts
tools.description: Find published Black Friday Brazil research charts by topic. Returns chart IDs, column labels, comparisons, periods and population. Use get_chart_data to retrieve the values.

tools.name: get_chart_data
tools.description: Retrieve a published chart with its values, units, comparison, period, population, source and methodology. Values keep their Portuguese display formatting. Follow next_cursor for remaining rows.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description: Retrieve source, canonical URL, dates, methodology, interpretation limits and reuse terms. Optionally include a chart-specific comparison, period and population.
